calls.statement:
SELECT 
  d.calendar_year,
  d.calendar_month,
  SUM(f.gross_amount) as sales_gross
FROM fact_sales_line f
INNER JOIN dim_date d ON f.sale_date = d.calendar_date
WHERE d.calendar_year = 2024 
  AND d.calendar_month IN (8, 9)
  AND f.staff_purchase_flag = FALSE
GROUP BY d.calendar_year, d.calendar_month
ORDER BY d.calendar_month

SELECT 
  d.calendar_month,
  COUNT(DISTINCT f.receipt_id) as receipt_count,
  COUNT(f.sales_line_id) as line_count,
  SUM(f.quantity) as units_sold,
  SUM(f.gross_amount) as sales_gross,
  MIN(f.sale_date) as first_sale,
  MAX(f.sale_date) as last_sale
FROM fact_sales_line f
INNER JOIN dim_date d ON f.sale_date = d.calendar_date
WHERE d.calendar_year = 2024 
  AND d.calendar_month IN (8, 9)
  AND f.staff_purchase_flag = FALSE
GROUP BY d.calendar_month
ORDER BY d.calendar_month

SELECT 
  d.calendar_month,
  f.channel_code,
  COUNT(DISTINCT f.receipt_id) as receipt_count,
  SUM(f.gross_amount) as sales_gross
FROM fact_sales_line f
INNER JOIN dim_date d ON f.sale_date = d.calendar_date
WHERE d.calendar_year = 2024 
  AND d.calendar_month IN (8, 9)
  AND f.staff_purchase_flag = FALSE
GROUP BY d.calendar_month, f.channel_code
ORDER BY d.calendar_month, f.channel_code
